#321 · Float Whale Pokémon

Wailord

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Wailord is a Water-type Float Whale Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 14.5 m tall and weighs 398 kg. It evolves from Wailmer. Its highest base stat is HP (170), with a base stat total of 500.
